layout_and_sections.description: Sticky dark-gold glassmorphism header with announcement ticker bar ('Worldwide Shipping • Jubilee Hills & California Boutiques • Book Virtual Consultation')
Editorial high-impact hero section with parallax backdrop image, masked metallic golden typography 'WE CELEBRATE YOU', countdown to wedding season, and dual call-to-action.
Continuous luxury marquee bar showcasing stats (1,00,000+ Outfits Created, 20,000+ Grooms Served, 4.8★ Google Rating, Jubilee Hills & Milpitas Boutiques)
Asymmetric Bento Grid showcasing 6 flagship named collections: Swarnalayam, Vaikunta Vaibhavam, Namam Collection, Peddamma Collection, Baraat Collection, and Royal Designer Suits.
Interactive 'See It On You' Virtual Try-On showcase modal trigger with mannequin toggle, body measurement selector, and instant live preview simulator.
Interactive product showcase rail with category filter tabs (Sherwanis, Indo-Western, Pattu Pancha, Tuxedos, Sadris, Kurtas) with real INR pricing and Quick View detail drawer.
Editorial visual grid mapping outfits to key wedding celebrations: Wedding Day, Reception, Sangeet Night, Haldi & Mehendi, Dhoti Ceremony, and Festive Galas.
Personal Stylist & Custom Tailoring booking banner with calendar date picker, store location picker (Hyderabad vs Milpitas vs Virtual Call), and direct Calendly modal integration.
Luxury photo-reviews wall featuring real grooms from USA and India with verified Google & Justdial 4.8★ rating badges.
Dual flagship store showcase (Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad & Milpitas, California) with store hours, map preview link, directions, and instant callback request.
Rich dark gold footer with brand manifesto, royal motif embroidery watermark, store address links, newsletter signup, and copyright statement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace stock splash screen completely in App.js.
Install and integrate Lenis smooth scrolling if possible or optimize Framer Motion scroll triggers.
Implement high-contrast dark gold aesthetics with crisp 1px borders (border-amber-500/30) and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-zinc-950/80).
Ensure ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, form inputs, modals) have explicit data-testid attributes defined in layout_and_sections.
Include full working contact / call-back modal and virtual try-on interactive drawer with state management.
Use direct product CDN images from GROOM2B and Unsplash photos provided in image_urls.
Do not use transparent dropdown backgrounds or low contrast grey text on dark backgrounds.
Ensure standard clean JS code without TypeScript syntax errors.
